artifacts.summary: Confirms the two Step 4c omissions; recommends appending classification records (class/citations/severity_max/suggested_channel_hints/channel-judgment/override-rationale) to specs/events.jsonl via events-append.sh rather than issues.jsonl (feedback-loop hazard) or a new file; enumerates every consumer transcribing the current task-creation design (postflight-tool-restrictions.md, orchestrate-state-machine.md, orchestrate-batch-results-template.md, test-orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh cases j/k); notes the deliberate consumer is already filed as task 421; flags the approval-gate-for-b/c question as an open decision for planning.

memory_candidates.content: When a stage must stop acting and start only recording evidence, and the evidence spans multiple tasks (cross-task grouped proposals), check whether the evidence target is itself part of the recording stage's own future read-set before choosing a store: writing a classification record back into a store the same stage later re-reads as fresh input (e.g. issues.jsonl under conclusion-stage.md's own filter predicate) creates a self-referential re-classification loop. A sibling store the stage never reads (events.jsonl) avoids this by construction, independent of schema fit.

events.jsonl's category enum (deviation/blocker/milestone/success) plus open event_type and additionalProperties:true detail already supports structured, non-deviation/non-blocker audit records with no schema revision -- push_grant_issued/push_grant_consumed (category:milestone) are the reference precedent for this shape. A new structured decision/classification record should follow that precedent (category:milestone, new documented event_type, rich detail object) rather than inventing a new file or forcing the record into deviation/blocker semantics.
